review_output: {"summary":"The producer and the tenant fence look fail-safe on the race paths given: proofs are written in Read Committed with a DB recheck, and readers recheck revisions in their Repeatable Read snapshot. Still blocked: the Original20 payment gate fails and the claim/finish probes are unfinished. Main risks: proof id not tied to scope, a revision scheme that only works if the ledger is never deleted from, possible gaps in what the ledger tracks, unbounded COUNT cost, and tenant-wide invalidation that can stop reports from ever finishing.","findings":[{"area":"release gate","file":"(WP evidence)","severity":"BLOCKER","confidence":0.95,"issue":"The Original20 synchronized-Serializable payment gate still fails and is not waived. The claim/finish mutation probes have not finished.","evidence":"Stated status: gate FAIL, probes still running, full WP incomplete.","impact":"No producer HTTP exposure or completeness claim is allowed. The payment race could still give wrong order denominators.","recommended_fix":"Fix the payment gate or waive it explicitly. Finish the claim/finish probes before exposing the producer.","required_test":"Original20 gate passes under synchronized Serializable; claim/finish probes go stale when tenant, order or registration counts change between the read and the lock."},{"area":"idempotence/correctness","file":"src/lib/live-metric-order-coverage.ts","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.6,"issue":"proofId is derived only from the digest. If the digest doesn't include vendor/live/version/startAt/endAt, two scopes can collide. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING then still returns 'recorded' without checking that the stored row matches.","evidence":"proofId = sha256(prefix+digest); the INSERT has no RETURNING or post-check; the function returns recorded unconditionally.","impact":"It reports success when no coverage was written. An empty audit in a second window keeps a stale or wrong proof, so that window reads unknown. Callers and logs are misled.","recommended_fix":"Hash the full scope and kind into proofId. Use RETURNING, or re-select the row and compare all bound columns; on mismatch return a conflict.","required_test":"Two windows with the same revisions and zero orders each produce their own covered row. A forced id collision returns a conflict, not recorded."},{"area":"false complete / revision monotonicity","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015230000_live_metric_order_tenant_report_binding/migration.sql","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.55,"issue":"Revisions are COUNTs of ledger rows. That is only safe if no ledger row is ever deleted. Retention pruning, cascade deletes or tenant cleanup can drop the count back to a value an old proof or report recorded (the ABA problem).","evidence":"The tenant fence is COUNT-based; this migration has no append-only enforcement or DELETE revoke on the ledger.","impact":"An outdated coverage proof or ready report becomes valid again: a false complete.","recommended_fix":"Make the ledgers append-only: a BEFORE DELETE/UPDATE trigger that raises, DELETE revoked from all roles, and no cascading foreign keys. Or switch to a monotonic per-tenant counter row.","required_test":"Deleting or truncating ledger rows is rejected, including through cascades. An ABA attempt does not revive an old proof."},{"area":"ledger completeness","file":"(tenant/registration ledger triggers)","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.5,"issue":"The listed ledger events (order relevant updates, payment insert/delete/metadata) may not cover every input the classifier reads, such as payment status, amount, orderId re-pointing, order vendorId moves, or identity fields used for identity_mismatch.","evidence":"The ledger spec lists only PaymentTransaction metadata updates. Classification also depends on payment presence and status plus registration and identity matching.","impact":"A change to a classifier input with no counter increment leaves the proof marked valid while the true classification has changed: a false complete.","recommended_fix":"List every column and table the classifier reads. Make each change increment a ledger, with both old and new tenant on moves.","required_test":"A property test: changing each classifier input column makes the existing proof and ready report read unknown or stale."},{"area":"performance","file":"src/lib/live-metric-coverage-reader.ts","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.7,"issue":"The tenant COUNT is O(size of tenant ledger), and the ledger grows forever. The reader evaluates it once per candidate row (up to 10001). Create, claim, finish, the guard and completion publish call it repeatedly while holding the version FOR UPDATE/SHARE lock.","evidence":"The reader's WHERE clause calls the revision functions per row. The guard, create, claim and finish each make about 3 count calls.","impact":"Large tenants hit the 5s statement timeout and lock contention. Reports become unavailable.","recommended_fix":"Compute the revisions once in a CTE in the reader. Replace COUNT with an O(1) per-tenant monotonic counter, or a bounded indexed aggregate.","required_test":"A benchmark with 10^6 ledger rows and 10^4 audit rows stays within latency and timeout budgets."},{"area":"liveness","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015230000_live_metric_order_tenant_report_binding/migration.sql","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.65,"issue":"The fence is tenant-wide. Any order or payment change anywhere in the tenant, including in other lives, other channels or after the window, invalidates every report and coverage proof.","evidence":"Create, claim, finish and publish all compare the full tenant COUNT. The producer needs no tenant change between the audit and the INSERT.","impact":"Under steady sales, a busy tenant may never get a ready report or recorded coverage, so they stay starved forever.","recommended_fix":"Limit the fence to the window: count ledger events whose old or new order createdAt falls in the half-open window. The window has ended, so that count settles.","required_test":"Continuous orders outside the window don't stop a report reaching ready. An order changed inside the window still invalidates it."},{"area":"lifecycle","file":"src/lib/live-metric-order-coverage.ts","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.5,"issue":"missing_payment and missing_attribution have no terminal exclusion. Abandoned unpaid orders and ordinary storefront orders block coverage permanently. 'incomplete' records no gap, so the loss is never persisted as evidence.","evidence":"Only matched, other_purpose, other_live and outside_cohort are accepted. An incomplete result returns early with no write.","impact":"Coverage stays unknown indefinitely, and operators get no persisted reason.","recommended_fix":"Add positively verified terminal classes, such as expired-unpaid or non-live channel. Record an 'orders' gap with the outcome counts when incomplete.","required_test":"A tenant with an abandoned cart or non-live order gets either a deterministic exclusion or a persisted gap row."},{"area":"DB guard / permissions","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015220000_live_metric_order_coverage_proof/migration.sql","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.6,"issue":"The guard only runs when an order column is non-null. A new 'orders'/'covered' row with every order column null is still accepted. orderCount is trusted from the caller, and nothing restricts the writer.","evidence":"The guard's outer IF is skipped when all four columns are NULL; no writer GUC like the report writer's.","impact":"Readers ignore such rows today. But a legacy or rogue writer, or a future reader change, could treat them as proof. Defense in depth is weak.","recommended_fix":"Add a NOT VALID CHECK so new orders/covered rows need all four columns. Require a producer writer setting, as report_writer does.","required_test":"Inserting an orders/covered row with null order columns, or outside the producer setting, is rejected."}]}
